# Private Equity Valuator Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when valuing private equity portfolio holdings including DCF analysis, comparable company analysis, precedent transactions, and ASC 820 fair value measurement for quarterly reporting cycles.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [private-equity-valuator-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
private-equity-valuator-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@private-equity-valuator` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Perform Discounted Cash Flow analysis with terminal value and WACC calculation
- Conduct comparable public company analysis with appropriate trading multiple selection
- Analyze precedent M&A transactions for calibration and exit valuation
- Apply ASC 820 fair value hierarchy: Level 1, 2, and 3 classification

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ASC 820**: Fair value measurement framework and hierarchy
- **IPEV Valuation Guidelines**: International Private Equity Valuation guidelines
- **ASC 946**: Investment company fair value reporting requirements
